description: Search for points of interest (POIs) — businesses, landmarks, restaurants, gas stations, etc. — by name or category, optionally near a lat/lon center within a radius. Returns name, category, address, coordinates, phone, url, and distance. Example: search_poi({ query: "coffee", lat: 40.748, lon: -73.985, radius: 1000 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

lat.description: Optional latitude of the search center to bias/limit results

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

lon.description: Optional longitude of the search center to bias/limit results

radius.description: Optional search radius in meters (only used when lat/lon are provided)

name: search_poi
title: Search Poi
